theory.heading: What P-Values and Significance is
theory.body: P-Values and Significance describes the methods and patterns used within Data Science to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.

theory.heading: Why P-Values and Significance matters
theory.body: Without P-Values and Significance, systems built with Data Science are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How P-Values and Significance works
theory.body: The mechanism behind P-Values and Significance follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of P-Values and Significance
theory.body: P-Values and Significance offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
